class.name: OcgGpSphere
class.brief_description: Describes a sphere. A sphere is defined by its radius and positioned in space with a coordinate system (a gp_Ax3 object). The origin of the coordinate system is the center of the sphere. This coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" of the sphere. Note: when a gp_Sphere sphere is converted into a Geom_SphericalSurface sphere, some implicit properties of its local coordinate system are used explicitly: - its origin, "X Direction", "Y Direction" and "main Direction" are used directly to define the parametric directions on the sphere and the origin of the parameters, - its implicit orientation (right-handed or left-handed) gives the orientation (direct, indirect) to the Geom_SphericalSurface sphere. See Also gce_MakeSphere which provides functions for more complex sphere constructions Geom_SphericalSurface which provides additional functions for constructing spheres and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of spheres.

method.name: gp_Sphere
method.description: Creates an indefinite sphere.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the center of the sphere.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Changes the local coordinate system of the sphere.

method.name: SetRadius
method.description: Assigns theR the radius of the Sphere. Warnings : It is not forbidden to create a sphere with null radius. Raises ConstructionError if theR < 0.0

method.name: Area
method.description: Computes the area of the sphere.

method.name: Coefficients
method.description: Computes the coefficients of the implicit equation of the quadric in the absolute cartesian coordinates system :

method.name: UReverse
method.description: Reverses the U parametrization of the sphere reversing the YAxis.

method.name: VReverse
method.description: Reverses the V parametrization of the sphere reversing the ZAxis.

method.name: Direct
method.description: Returns true if the local coordinate system of this sphere is right-handed.

method.name: Location
method.description: --- Purpose ; Returns the center of the sphere.

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the local coordinates system of the sphere.

method.name: Radius
method.description: Returns the radius of the sphere.

method.name: Volume
method.description: Computes the volume of the sphere

method.name: XAxis
method.description: Returns the axis X of the sphere.

method.name: YAxis
method.description: Returns the axis Y of the sphere.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a sphere with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a sphere with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a sphere with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the of the symmetry : (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a sphere. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a sphere. theS is the scaling value. The absolute value of S is used to scale the sphere

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a sphere with the transformation theT from class Trsf.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates a sphere in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates a sphere from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
